ov: One of the two largest living lemurs, black and white with a stump of a tail, found only in the forests of eastern Madagascar. Mated pairs stay together for life with their young, and groups sing loud, haunting songs almost every day. It is Critically Endangered.

why.et: Many Malagasy taboos (fady) protect it, but it is still hunted and in some regions its meat is prized.

rg: Lowland and mountain forests along the east coast of Madagascar.
df: Mainly young, tender leaves, plus seeds, fruit and flowers.
fx: Only one indri has lived more than a year in captivity, and none has ever bred there.
Songs last from 45 seconds to over three minutes, and neighbouring groups answer each other.
